name: runner-profile-integration
goal: Normal Vitest and Bun runners emit actual source-bound profiles while preserving production builds, benchmark boundaries and fixture isolation.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Direct adapter proof is green but no standard runner installs it. Actual Vitest and Bun child fixture operations return correct values with no captures. Production builds and unowned files must stay untouched.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend standardized source profiling to real runner imports and subprocesses. Require latency and RSS per executing runner, preserve source bytes and build artifacts, and prove ordinary, benchmark and unowned paths remain unobserved.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed f46368e1 red49719640: two real capture-count assertions fail, while ordinary and benchmark boundaries and unowned source pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Install evidence-only Vitest transform and a bounded Bun runtime hook. Use a separate owned sink and schema-validated registry; explicitly transpile TS and pass Bun preload as one equals-form option.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: All nine unchanged adapter/runner cases pass. Vitest and Bun observations are distinct; build output stays original. Type, lint, audit and registry checks pass. Normal project configs are not yet enabled.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red1e8dd29f atf46368e1 and green65cd3907 at62fb785a execute the same four-case corpus and command in one environment; all cases pass on repair.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated pre-integration source f46368e1 returns correct operation results but fails two capture assertions; repaired62fb785a passes with both runner observations and unchanged fixture/build isolation.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
